lenses.name: Population
lenses.description: Population per square kilometer by province (PSA 2024 Census).

lenses.name: Pop. growth
lenses.description: Population percent change between the 2020 and 2024 Censuses.

lenses.name: Median income
lenses.description: Median annual family income in Philippine Pesos (PSA FIES 2023).

lenses.name: GDP per capita
lenses.description: Gross Domestic Product per person (PSA Provincial Product Accounts 2024).

lenses.name: Poverty
lenses.description: Poverty incidence among population by province (PSA 2023).

lenses.name: Urbanization
lenses.description: Share of residents living in urban barangays (PSA 2024 Census).

lenses.name: Internet use
lenses.description: Share of individuals aged 10+ using the internet (PSA 2024, regional figures).
lenses.note: Published at the regional level by PSA; provinces inherit their region's rate.

lenses.name: Typhoons
lenses.description: Distinct tropical cyclones passing through or adjacent to each province since 1980 (NOAA IBTrACS).
lenses.note: Counts storm tracks passing within ~25 km of the province; tracks do not measure wind damage.

lenses.name: Earthquakes
lenses.description: Magnitude 5.0+ earthquakes located in or adjacent to each province since 1980 (USGS).

lenses.name: Forest cover
lenses.description: Share of land classified as forestland (PSA 2021 & relief model).
